lines.speaker: A
lines.pinyin: Nǐ hǎo! Nǐ jiào shénme míngzi?

lines.speaker: B
lines.pinyin: Wǒ jiào Lǐ Míng. Nǐ ne?
lines.english: My name is Li Ming. And you?

lines.speaker: A
lines.hanzi: 我叫张伟。很高兴认识你。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ jiào Zhāng Wěi. Hěn gāoxìng rènshi nǐ.
lines.english: My name is Zhang Wei. Nice to meet you.

lines.speaker: B
lines.hanzi: 我也很高兴认识你。你是哪国人？
lines.pinyin: Wǒ yě hěn gāoxìng rènshi nǐ. Nǐ shì nǎ guó rén?
lines.english: I'm also glad to meet you. Which country are you from?

lines.speaker: A
lines.hanzi: 我是美国人。你是中国人吗？
lines.pinyin: Wǒ shì Měiguó rén. Nǐ shì Zhōngguó rén ma?
lines.english: I am American. Are you Chinese?

lines.speaker: B
lines.hanzi: 是的，我是中国人。我住在北京。
lines.pinyin: Shì de, wǒ shì Zhōngguó rén. Wǒ zhù zài Běijīng.
lines.english: Yes, I am Chinese. I live in Beijing.

lines.speaker: A
lines.hanzi: 北京很好。我也想去北京。
lines.pinyin: Běijīng hěn hǎo. Wǒ yě xiǎng qù Běijīng.
lines.english: Beijing is great. I also want to go to Beijing.
